notes.title: Launch Update 1.0
notes.content:
After over 6 months of early access we're launching into 1.0! The feedback has been great and we've made some pretty big changes to the game in that time. Thanks to all who participated in the early access release.

Look out for more ghosts, more items, and some other little surprises in the 1.0 version of the game. We're excited to see everyone get a chance to play it!

All bow to the mighty (and jiggly) False King! A new big boss is in town and he doesn't want to give up the Mask of Okeem so easily. Good luck!

Changes:
[list]
[*] The False King must be defeated to acquire the Mask of Okeem
[*] Fixed a bug with the UI displaying incorrectly in the chambers
[/list]
[i]
** You can always access the previous build using the Betas tab in preferences[/i]

notes.content:
Mysterious statues are appearing in the haunted tower.
These [i]relics [/i]of Weirdwood seem to contain a spectral energy.
But how curious that they seem to present a challenge?
What rewards or dangers might they bring?

[*] New collectable green fragments (what could these be for?)
[/list]

notes.title: Spectro Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Spectro is out now in Early Access! It's been a long time coming and we're really excited to share it with everyone. Right now you get the core experience of venturing into the ever-changing, haunted tower of Weirdwood and fighting off ghosts to reach the coveted Mask of Okeem. There is treasure to be looted and gear to be upgraded, along with mini puzzles that make each floor challenging.

We have so much content planned for release throughout early access and we can't wait to show you guys what's next. We want to continue development alongside the community of players to help guide new features so please follow along and join the discussion on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/719520/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/fTXAV44]Discord server[/url].

A couple key features on our road map:
- full Index and WMR support
- more floor challenges to mix things up a bit
- more blaster types with different properties
- more ghost types with a variety of skins
- bosses!
- and much more...

Thanks for coming along on this journey with us just in time for All Hallows' Eve ːsteamhappyː
